_comment: Library expansion: eight remaining Bach Two-Part Inventions. Sources are pinned to online Mutopia downloads and validated against published MIDI.

pieces.title: Invention No. 2 in C minor
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond MIDI block of the source, quarter = 64; no printed metronome mark. A measured study tempo for independent two-part counterpoint.
pieces.levelNote: Level 4: intermediate independent two-part counterpoint, consistent with the existing Inventions 1, 4 and 8 in this collection (Henle HN 1591 / RCM syllabus anchors documented in bach.json). The heuristic proposes 3 (score 4.996); sustained hand independence justifies intermediate placement.
pieces.notes: Engraved by Allen Garvin from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition and placed in the public domain. Online RDF and published MIDI checked during the expansion build.

pieces.notes: Engraved by Allen Garvin from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition and placed in the public domain. Online RDF and published MIDI checked during the expansion build. The obsolete old-relative option is removed before convert-ly; the published MIDI independently checks the resulting pitches. A second syntax patch quotes the obsolete empty-list grace-flag style value; engraving only, with pitches checked against both MIDI files.

patches.replace: % digitus2: removed obsolete old-relative option; MIDI cross-check verifies pitches

pieces.notes: Engraved by jeff covey from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition, licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. Attribution: jeff covey / Mutopia Project; this MusicXML adaptation uses the same license. Online RDF and published MIDI checked during the expansion build. Two syntax-only catalog patches replace terminal rehearsal-mark fermata glyphs with directed fermatas at the same bar-62 events: upright on the right-hand final eighth rest, inverted on the left-hand final E eighth note. Original markup marks are removed; all note/rest timings and MIDI remain unchanged.

rejected.reason: Exact against both source MIDIs and valid MusicXML, but the converter omits directional upmordent/downmordent ornament notation. Substitution with prallmordent would lose approach direction and is not accepted for this expansion. Requires faithful shared-converter ornament support before reinstatement.

rejected.reason: Both MIDI cross-checks exact (558/558), XSD valid, and zero span/law errors, but visual review finds literal scripts.turn text in bar 16. Delayed turn and combined mordent/turn LilyPond markups have no faithful converter mapping; dropping or moving these ornaments is not accepted.
